visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a male host wearing a white chef's jacket and a black apron. He stands in a bright studio with a grey brick-patterned background, gesturing enthusiastically toward three packaged food items on a wooden table. Large orange and yellow text overlays appear in front of him. (2) The scene cuts to the host holding a green and yellow snack bag (Koloko brand). He performs an exaggerated sniffing motion. Close-up shots show spiral-shaped chips being poured into a white ceramic bowl, revealing a fine green herb seasoning on their surface. (3) The host is shown eating the chips and giving a thumbs-up. Animated heart icons and 'variety-show' style text bubbles pop up around his head to emphasize his positive reaction. The lighting remains bright and even throughout. (4) He then presents a transparent plastic container filled with macaroons. A macro close-up reveals the macaroon has a light beige shell and a vibrant green cream filling. The host bites into one and displays the interior to the camera. (5) Next, he introduces a small green plastic cup of steamed egg (chawanmushi). He uses a golden spoon to scoop out the smooth, pale yellow custard, showing pieces of mushroom and crab stick inside. A small logo for Sushi Express is briefly overlaid. (6) The host returns to the initial medium framing, holding the macaroon package and gesturing with both hands as he delivers a concluding summary, inviting viewers to comment.
